column1: # Game profile of Hogwarts Legacy (Switch, update 1.0.5 = v327680 over the base game 1.0.0 = v0)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Avalanche Software / Warner Bros. Games, Unreal Engine 4.27.2 (EpicGames+UnrealEngine-4_27_2 in main; the desktop renderer, SF_GLSL_SWITCH shaders), SDK 17.5.4, NVN, Wwise sound, Bink movies.
# Status: provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey, peanuts/docs/NEW-GAME.md), not booted yet; the note (README.md) says what is a guess
# The shader tables are the update's (v327680); a base game dump has other shader code archives (README.md)
# PEANUTS: the app builds 1.0.5 only (the shader tables are of 1.0.5)
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (main imports from it)
# Unreal Engine 4.27.2: nninitStartup (main+0x19ecfc4) reserves one address region for the engine (62 GB by default); the rewriter's engine-wide gate on the store of its size
# (dm/tools/ue_region.py, main+0x19ed298) gives it what the alias region has room for. Its FMallocBinned3 is not cut (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py finds no UTF-16 name: this build's TCHAR is 8-bit,
# and with an 8-bit name its vtable has the name getter in slot 23, a layout hle_uemalloc.c does not know), so Unreal's own allocator runs and reserves its pools (37 GB of address
# space) in that region: the survey's 64 GB alias region (address space only on Android, docs/reference/memory.md), 256 MB stacks, 128 MB heap. Not measured
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# A 3D game whose camera the right stick turns: the 3D pad layout
# The shader code archives of the paks (ShaderArchive-Global-SF_GLSL_SWITCH in pakchunk0, ShaderArchive-Phoenix_Chunk0 / _Chunk9 / _Chunk10 in pakchunk0, 9 and 10), stored in the pak, every shader in
# them Oodle Kraken-compressed (block header 8C 06). Unreal combines vertex and pixel shaders per draw from its pipeline state, so every vertex shader is made to link with any pixel shader

# PEANUTS: frame rate, FPSLocker Warehouse 0100F7E00C70E000/0C00FC37B0610FBD.yaml (1.0.5): r.DynamicRes.FrameTimeBudget, t.MaxFPS, r.VSync off. Unreal steps by elapsed time; marked experimental (README, Frame rate)

# PEANUTS: Game owned (its own 30 fps, interval 2) until the player picks a limit. Since 0.1.8 fps_limit_present puts the game on the frame limit list, whose default is Game owned; this row is a safety net. In 0.1.7 the launcher passed the main screen's cap of 60 and FPSLocker interval 1 with no limit, an uncapped 24-37 fps that heated a Galaxy S24 Ultra into its GPU throttle (2026-11-24)
# PEANUTS: the thermal cap on Android (opt-in): a frame limit above 30 holds 30 while the phone is severe or worse (README, Frame rate)
